guides.title: 矽穿孔背面露出：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Through-silicon-via backside reveal: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 背面露出有矽殘留與過度去除兩種風險。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Backside reveal risks both silicon residue and over-removal. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：背面露出有矽殘留與過度去除兩種風險。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較晶圓厚度圖與每區露出高度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Backside reveal risks both silicon residue and over-removal. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare wafer thickness maps and local reveal height. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較晶圓厚度圖與每區露出高度」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare wafer thickness maps and local reveal height, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「深度座標」建立判讀邊界。TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Depth coordinates to define the interpretation boundary. TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜深度座標：統一圖面和量測零點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜終點感測：以局部量測核對全域終點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜露出驗收：建立逐區幾何電性對照。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Depth coordinates: Unify design and metrology zero references. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Endpoint sensing: Check global endpoints against local measurements. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Reveal acceptance: Build regional geometry/electrical comparisons. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「終點感測」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「露出驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Endpoint sensing: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Reveal acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：全域終點一出現即可停止且全部完成。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Subtracting depths without checking datums. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Stopping at first global endpoint as complete reveal. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 矽中介層佈線：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Silicon-interposer routing: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 中介層提供細間距佈線但增加界面。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An interposer adds fine routing and additional interfaces. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：中介層提供細間距佈線但增加界面。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：標示水平配線、垂直通孔與返回路徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: An interposer adds fine routing and additional interfaces. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Mark horizontal routing, vertical vias and return paths. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「標示水平配線、垂直通孔與返回路徑」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Mark horizontal routing, vertical vias and return paths, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 矽中介層佈線：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon-interposer routing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「被動與主動中介層」建立判讀邊界。是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Passive and active interposers to define the interpretation boundary. Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜被動與主動中介層：標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜TSV 分配：建立 TSV 網路與電流密度圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜共同簽核：檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Passive and active interposers: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | TSV allocation: Build TSV net and current-density maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Co-signoff: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「TSV 分配」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「共同簽核」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for TSV allocation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Co-signoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：地 TSV 可只按剩餘空間放置。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating all silicon interposers as passive. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Placing ground TSVs only in leftover space. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

觀察站 2｜分析順應性：觀察焦點：比較剛性與順應中介層的受力路徑。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成中介層交接：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列明不能由公開架構圖推定的製造參數。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Partition dies and interposer: Observation focus: Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Analyze compliance: Observation focus: Compare load paths in rigid and compliant interposers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete interposer handoff: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List manufacturing parameters not inferable from public architecture diagrams. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分析順應性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Analyze compliance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete interposer handoff: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「劃分晶粒與中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「分析順應性」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到聚合物可分散某些應力，但也帶來蠕變和翹曲變化。所指出的物理限制。

pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for partition dies and interposer actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition.

Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for analyze compliance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Polymers redistribute some stress but introduce creep and warpage variation.

guides.title: 玻璃核心封裝基板：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Glass-core package substrates: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。此 BGA 截面僅示意接點與基板位置，不能確認其核心材料是玻璃。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：將核心翹曲、通孔裂紋和增層界面分開。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This BGA section locates joints and substrate but does not establish a glass-core material. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Separate core warpage, via cracks and build-up interfaces. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「將核心翹曲、通孔裂紋和增層界面分開」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Separate core warpage, via cracks and build-up interfaces, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「定義核心與增層」建立判讀邊界。核心負責機械支撐及穿通，外側增層負責細密佈線。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define core and build-up to define the interpretation boundary. The core supports mechanics and through-connections; outer build-up handles fine routing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義核心與增層：觀察焦點：將核心和增層分色標示。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜估算熱失配：觀察焦點：重算 12 μm 差位移並說明不是裂紋張開量。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜評估研究成熟度：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：用公開證據標註已證明與仍待證明事項。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define core and build-up: Observation focus: Color core and build-up separately. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Estimate thermal mismatch: Observation focus: Recalculate 12 μm mismatch and explain why it is not crack opening. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Assess research maturity: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Label demonstrated and unresolved claims from public evidence. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「估算熱失配」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「評估研究成熟度：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Estimate thermal mismatch: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Assess research maturity: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：玻璃平整就不會產生裂紋。本步先檢查「定義核心與增層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到核心負責機械支撐及穿通，外側增層負責細密佈線。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：玻璃平整就不會產生裂紋。本步先檢查「估算熱失配」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到玻璃和銅膨脹不同會在孔口及端面形成局部負荷。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Flat glass cannot crack. First check whether evidence for define core and build-up actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: The core supports mechanics and through-connections; outer build-up handles fine routing.

Misinterpretation to reject: Flat glass cannot crack. First check whether evidence for estimate thermal mismatch actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Glass-copper mismatch loads via entrances and ends locally.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: ABF build-up depends on dielectric and microvia quality. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。此 BGA 截面不能辨識樹脂化學成分，也不能確認使用 ABF 材料。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。

選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。

procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識 ABF 功能：觀察焦點：畫銅線與介電層而不混為一層。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify ABF function: Observation focus: Draw copper and dielectric as separate layers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Control seed and plating: Observation focus: Check via entrance, middle and bottom. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver substrate evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List checks required after a material revision. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Control seed and plating: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver substrate evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: ABF is conductive copper foil. First check whether evidence for identify abf function actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: ABF provides interlayer insulation and a routing foundation; copper conducts.

guides.title: 小晶片互連實體層：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Chiplet-interconnect physical layers: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 實體層通道必須包含封裝返回路徑。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A physical-layer channel includes the package return path. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：實體層通道必須包含封裝返回路徑。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用眼圖、BER 與通道 S 參數連結驗證。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: A physical-layer channel includes the package return path. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Link eye, BER and channel S-parameter evidence. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用眼圖、BER 與通道 S 參數連結驗證」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Link eye, BER and channel S-parameter evidence, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 小晶片互連實體層：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Chiplet-interconnect physical layers: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分離 PHY 與協定」建立判讀邊界。電氣傳輸、連結管理與上層資料語義處於不同層。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate PHY and protocol to define the interpretation boundary. Electrical transport, link management and data semantics occupy different layers. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分離 PHY 與協定：觀察焦點：畫出資料由協定到焊墊的邊界。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜理解初始化與訓練：觀察焦點：畫出上電到可傳有效資料的狀態。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付連結證據：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：寫出未經測試的相容性主張。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate PHY and protocol: Observation focus: Draw boundaries from protocol to pads. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Understand initialization and training: Observation focus: Draw states from power-on to valid data transfer. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver link evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List compatibility claims that remain untested. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「理解初始化與訓練」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付連結證據：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Understand initialization and training: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver link evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：支援相同協定就保證電氣互通。本步先檢查「分離 PHY 與協定」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到電氣傳輸、連結管理與上層資料語義處於不同層。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：支援相同協定就保證電氣互通。本步先檢查「理解初始化與訓練」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到連線建立需確認時鐘、通道與能力，不只看到資料切換。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: The same protocol guarantees electrical interoperability. First check whether evidence for separate phy and protocol actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Electrical transport, link management and data semantics occupy different layers.

Misinterpretation to reject: The same protocol guarantees electrical interoperability. First check whether evidence for understand initialization and training actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Link establishment verifies clocks, lanes and capabilities, not just transitions.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 封裝供電完整性設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package power-integrity design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 封裝供電完整性包含頻率相關阻抗。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Package power integrity involves frequency-dependent impedance. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：封裝供電完整性包含頻率相關阻抗。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：把 DC 壓降與瞬時壓降頻譜分開。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Package power integrity involves frequency-dependent impedance. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Separate DC voltage drop from transient-droop spectra. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「把 DC 壓降與瞬時壓降頻譜分開」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Separate DC voltage drop from transient-droop spectra, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝供電完整性設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Package power-integrity design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分配電壓容差」建立判讀邊界。DC 壓降、動態下陷和漣波共用有限容差，需避免重複計算。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Allocate voltage tolerance to define the interpretation boundary. DC drop, dynamic droop and ripple share finite tolerance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分配電壓容差：觀察焦點：把電壓預算分成獨立欄位。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜建構去耦頻帶：觀察焦點：標示各去耦支路共振與感性區。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付供電證據：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：指出哪個角點消耗最多容差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Allocate voltage tolerance: Observation focus: Split the voltage budget into separate terms. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Construct decoupling bands: Observation focus: Mark resonant and inductive regions of each branch. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver PI evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Identify which corner consumes most tolerance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建構去耦頻帶」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付供電證據：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Construct decoupling bands: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver PI evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：DC 壓降合格就保證所有瞬態合格。本步先檢查「分配電壓容差」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到DC 壓降、動態下陷和漣波共用有限容差，需避免重複計算。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：DC 壓降合格就保證所有瞬態合格。本步先檢查「建構去耦頻帶」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到ESR、ESL 和安裝路徑決定支路有效範圍。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing DC drop guarantees all transients. First check whether evidence for allocate voltage tolerance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: DC drop, dynamic droop and ripple share finite tolerance.

Misinterpretation to reject: Passing DC drop guarantees all transients. First check whether evidence for construct decoupling bands actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: ESR, ESL and mounting determine branch effectiveness.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Identify seam leakage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver band-specific shield evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

If not, revisit the physical constraint: Spectrum and sensitive nodes define shielding needs, not only maximum clock.

guides.title: 晶圓級真空封裝：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Wafer-level vacuum packaging: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 真空封裝同時受漏氣及放氣影響。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Vacuum packages are affected by leakage and outgassing. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認功率模組外殼與引腳；封裝內部陶瓷、銀燒結及雙面冷卻結構沒有顯露。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：真空封裝同時受漏氣及放氣影響。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較封裝壓力隨時間及溫度的變化。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify housing and pins; internal ceramics, silver sintering and double-sided cooling are not visible.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Vacuum packages are affected by leakage and outgassing. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Compare pressure versus time and temperature. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。

evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare pressure versus time and temperature, including units and sources of uncertainty.

guides.title: 晶圓級真空封裝：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer-level vacuum packaging: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「連結器件與真空需求」建立判讀邊界。氣體阻尼會改變 MEMS 共振品質因子，但 Q 值也受固體損耗影響。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Connect device to vacuum need to define the interpretation boundary. Gas damping affects MEMS quality factor, but solid losses also affect Q. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜連結器件與真空需求：觀察焦點：列出不能由 Q 值單獨分辨的損耗。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜選擇吸氣機制：觀察焦點：把氣體負載與可吸收成分對照。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付真空保持資料：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列一項可能導致錯估壽命的未量測氣體。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Connect device to vacuum need: Observation focus: List losses that Q alone cannot distinguish. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Select getter mechanism: Observation focus: Match gas loads to species the getter can pump. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver vacuum-retention evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Name an unmeasured gas that could bias life prediction. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「選擇吸氣機制」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付真空保持資料：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Select getter mechanism: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver vacuum-retention evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：真空接合後壓力永遠固定。本步先檢查「連結器件與真空需求」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到氣體阻尼會改變 MEMS 共振品質因子，但 Q 值也受固體損耗影響。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：真空接合後壓力永遠固定。本步先檢查「選擇吸氣機制」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到吸氣能力有氣體選擇性與容量限制，不能以覆蓋面積直接保證壽命。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Pressure stays fixed forever after vacuum bonding. First check whether evidence for connect device to vacuum need actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Gas damping affects MEMS quality factor, but solid losses also affect Q.

Misinterpretation to reject: Pressure stays fixed forever after vacuum bonding. First check whether evidence for select getter mechanism actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Getter action is species-selective and capacity-limited; area alone cannot guarantee life.

guides.title: 功率模組雙面散熱：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Double-sided cooling of power modules: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 雙面散熱必須兼顧電絕緣與平坦度。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Double-sided cooling must preserve insulation and flatness. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。用外置冷板比較對流表面與流阻；不是蝕刻在晶片內部的微流道。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：雙面散熱必須兼顧電絕緣與平坦度。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：建立上下兩條熱路與接觸邊界。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Compare convective area and flow restriction in an external cold plate; these are not microchannels etched inside a chip.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Double-sided cooling must preserve insulation and flatness. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Model both heat paths and their contact boundaries. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「建立上下兩條熱路與接觸邊界」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Model both heat paths and their contact boundaries, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 功率模組雙面散熱：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Double-sided cooling of power modules: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義上下熱出口」建立判讀邊界。雙面可增加散熱路徑，但兩側未必同溫或等效。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define upper and lower exits to define the interpretation boundary. Two sides add heat paths but need not be isothermal or equivalent. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義上下熱出口：觀察焦點：分別列出兩側冷卻邊界。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜分配上下熱流：觀察焦點：解算等冷端算例，再改一側冷端升溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付共同驗收：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：為每條件指定量測與保留疑問。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define upper and lower exits: Observation focus: List cooling boundaries separately for each side. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Allocate heat sharing: Observation focus: Solve the equal-cold-side example, then warm one cold side. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver joint acceptance: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Assign a measurement and open question to each requirement. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分配上下熱流」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付共同驗收：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Allocate heat sharing: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver joint acceptance: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：雙面散熱永遠剛好降低一半接面溫度。本步先檢查「定義上下熱出口」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到雙面可增加散熱路徑，但兩側未必同溫或等效。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：雙面散熱永遠剛好降低一半接面溫度。本步先檢查「分配上下熱流」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到熱流分配取決於各支路熱阻及冷端溫度。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Double-sided cooling always halves junction temperature. First check whether evidence for define upper and lower exits actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Two sides add heat paths but need not be isothermal or equivalent.

Misinterpretation to reject: Double-sided cooling always halves junction temperature. First check whether evidence for allocate heat sharing actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Heat sharing depends on branch resistance and cold-side temperature.

guides.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package thermal-cycling reliability: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：記錄溫差、停留、升降速率及失效位置。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Record range, dwell, ramp rate and failure location. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「記錄溫差、停留、升降速率及失效位置」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Record range, dwell, ramp rate and failure location, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Package thermal-cycling reliability: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義服役溫度史」建立判讀邊界。幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define service thermal history to define the interpretation boundary. Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義服役溫度史：觀察焦點：列完整時間軸而非只寫高低溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜定位首發失效：觀察焦點：結合分段測試與影像縮小位置。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成可靠度結論：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：寫出資料能支持與不能支持的壽命主張。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define service thermal history: Observation focus: Record a full timeline, not only extremes. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Locate first failure: Observation focus: Combine segmented testing and imaging to localize. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete reliability conclusion: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: State which life claims the data support and do not support. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「定位首發失效」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成可靠度結論：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Locate first failure: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete reliability conclusion: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定義服役溫度史」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定位首發失效」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到串聯菊鏈只指出某段異常，不能直接識別每個焊點。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for define service thermal history actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage.

Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for locate first failure actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A daisy chain identifies a faulty segment, not automatically the individual joint.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: X 光投影重疊不能當作三維斷層。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。

選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This Quilt Packaging microscopy image is not an X-ray CT slice or tomographic reconstruction. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Smaller voxels always give proportionally higher resolution. First check whether evidence for define inspection target actually supports the mechanism. Misinterpretation to reject: Smaller voxels always give proportionally higher resolution. First check whether evidence for select reconstruction and correction actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Filtering, ring correction and denoising can alter detail.

guides.concept: 先用「畫出 SOI 截面」建立判讀邊界。矽核心、埋氧與上包覆共同決定模態，不只核心寬度。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw SOI cross-section to define the interpretation boundary. Silicon core, buried oxide and top cladding jointly determine modes. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出 SOI 截面：觀察焦點：標記 strip 與 rib 的不同邊界。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜建立 cutback 結構：觀察焦點：列出長度改變時保持固定的項目。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付波導模型：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：用未參與擬合的波導驗證預測。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw SOI cross-section: Observation focus: Mark differing strip and rib boundaries. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Build cutback structures: Observation focus: List terms held fixed when changing length. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver waveguide model: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Validate against a waveguide excluded from fitting. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立 cutback 結構」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付波導模型：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Build cutback structures: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver waveguide model: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：有效折射率與群折射率相同。本步先檢查「畫出 SOI 截面」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到矽核心、埋氧與上包覆共同決定模態，不只核心寬度。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：有效折射率與群折射率相同。本步先檢查「建立 cutback 結構」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到不同長度需共用可比耦合與彎曲條件。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Effective index equals group index. First check whether evidence for draw soi cross-section actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Silicon core, buried oxide and top cladding jointly determine modes.

Misinterpretation to reject: Effective index equals group index. First check whether evidence for build cutback structures actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Different lengths require comparable couplers and bends.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 氮化矽低損耗波導：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Low-loss silicon-nitride waveguides: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: SiN 低損耗需要分開吸收與散射。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Low-loss SiN requires separating absorption and scattering. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。作為光子材料製備設備及無塵操作情境；不代表特定 SiN、SOI 或量產配方。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：SiN 低損耗需要分開吸收與散射。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用波長與長度掃描找出損耗來源。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Context for photonics material preparation and clean handling, not a particular SiN, SOI or production recipe.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Low-loss SiN requires separating absorption and scattering. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use wavelength and length sweeps to investigate loss origin. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用波長與長度掃描找出損耗來源」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use wavelength and length sweeps to investigate loss origin, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 氮化矽低損耗波導：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Low-loss silicon-nitride waveguides: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「選定工作頻帶」建立判讀邊界。低損耗需連到特定波長，鍵結吸收與包覆會形成頻譜限制。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Choose operating band to define the interpretation boundary. Low loss is wavelength-specific; bond absorption and cladding limit spectra. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜選定工作頻帶：觀察焦點：標記預定波段及可能吸收區。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜配置低損耗量測：觀察焦點：增加有效長差並保留漂移參考。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付低損耗主張：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：區分單顆最佳值與跨晶片分布。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Choose operating band: Observation focus: Mark operating and possible absorption bands. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Plan low-loss measurement: Observation focus: Increase effective length difference and retain a drift reference. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a low-loss claim: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Separate best-device results from cross-die distributions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「配置低損耗量測」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付低損耗主張：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Plan low-loss measurement: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a low-loss claim: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：負載 Q 可不經校正直接當內部 Q。本步先檢查「選定工作頻帶」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到低損耗需連到特定波長，鍵結吸收與包覆會形成頻譜限制。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：負載 Q 可不經校正直接當內部 Q。本步先檢查「配置低損耗量測」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到損耗很低時，短測試線差值接近量測漂移。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Loaded Q directly equals intrinsic Q. First check whether evidence for choose operating band actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Low loss is wavelength-specific; bond absorption and cladding limit spectra.

Misinterpretation to reject: Loaded Q directly equals intrinsic Q. First check whether evidence for plan low-loss measurement actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: At very low loss, short-length differences approach measurement drift.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Subwavelength-grating waveguides: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 次波長單元的有效介質近似有適用條件。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An effective-medium approximation has limits for subwavelength cells. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：次波長單元的有效介質近似有適用條件。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：檢查週期、占空比及波長的比例。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: An effective-medium approximation has limits for subwavelength cells. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Check ratios of period, duty cycle and wavelength. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「檢查週期、占空比及波長的比例」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check ratios of period, duty cycle and wavelength, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「定義週期方向」建立判讀邊界。週期必須相對傳播方向與偏振定義。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define periodic direction to define the interpretation boundary. Period must be defined relative to propagation and polarization. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義週期方向：觀察焦點：畫單胞、週期與光傳播向量。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜設計漸變轉接：觀察焦點：比較突變與漸變填充比轉接。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付 SWG 模型：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：指出有效介質與全波結果差異最大的點。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define periodic direction: Observation focus: Draw unit cell, period and propagation vector. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Design gradual transitions: Observation focus: Compare abrupt and tapered fill-factor transitions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver SWG model: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Identify the largest effective-medium/full-wave discrepancy. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設計漸變轉接」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付 SWG 模型：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Design gradual transitions: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver SWG model: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：只要週期小於自由空間波長就沒有 Bragg 效應。本步先檢查「定義週期方向」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到週期必須相對傳播方向與偏振定義。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：只要週期小於自由空間波長就沒有 Bragg 效應。本步先檢查「設計漸變轉接」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到傳統波導到 SWG 的模態不匹配會造成額外損耗。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Any period below free-space wavelength avoids Bragg effects. First check whether evidence for define periodic direction actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Period must be defined relative to propagation and polarization.

Misinterpretation to reject: Any period below free-space wavelength avoids Bragg effects. First check whether evidence for design gradual transitions actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mode mismatch between conventional and SWG guides adds loss.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Edge-coupler design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 邊緣模式轉換與端面品質共同決定耦合。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Mode conversion and facet quality jointly set edge coupling. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：邊緣模式轉換與端面品質共同決定耦合。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：掃描橫向偏移與端面間隙的插入損耗。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Mode conversion and facet quality jointly set edge coupling. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Scan insertion loss against lateral offset and facet gap. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「掃描橫向偏移與端面間隙的插入損耗」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Scan insertion loss against lateral offset and facet gap, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Edge-coupler design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「比較晶片與光纖模場」建立判讀邊界。模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare chip and fiber modes to define the interpretation boundary. Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜比較晶片與光纖模場：觀察焦點：畫同功率正規化的兩模場。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜建立橫向容差：觀察焦點：重算 1 μm 偏移的 1.09 dB 例。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付耦合器規格：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：把模場半徑與直徑寫成兩個不同欄位。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare chip and fiber modes: Observation focus: Draw two equal-power normalized fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Build lateral tolerance: Observation focus: Recalculate 1.09 dB loss at 1 μm offset. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver coupler specification: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Record mode radius and diameter as separate fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立橫向容差」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付耦合器規格：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Build lateral tolerance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver coupler specification: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「比較晶片與光纖模場」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「建立橫向容差」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到較大模場可增加偏移容忍，但也改變封裝尺寸需求。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for compare chip and fiber modes actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers.

Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for build lateral tolerance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Larger modes tolerate offset but alter package requirements.

guides.title: 光纖陣列主動對準：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Active alignment of fiber arrays: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 主動對準尋找光功率最大值而非影像中心。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Active alignment maximizes optical power, not image centering. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：主動對準尋找光功率最大值而非影像中心。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：保留搜尋軌跡、多通道功率及固定後損失。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Active alignment maximizes optical power, not image centering. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Record search trajectories, channel powers and post-fixation loss. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「保留搜尋軌跡、多通道功率及固定後損失」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Record search trajectories, channel powers and post-fixation loss, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

AIM Photonics: Test, Assembly and Packaging

guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 光纖陣列主動對準：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Active alignment of fiber arrays: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義光功率參考面：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。輸出讀值同時含雷射、纖線、耦合與晶片路徑；搜尋目標須先正規化。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define optical power reference planes: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Output includes source, fiber, coupling and chip paths; normalize the objective before searching. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義光功率參考面：模型與設計：使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。
觀察站 2｜設定陣列目標函數：模型與設計：以一強一弱通道比較總和最大與最差通道最大兩解。
觀察站 3｜交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別：重複卸載重裝並比較每通道分布，不只報一次最佳值。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define optical power reference planes: model and design: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change.
Observation station 2 | Set an array objective: model and design: Compare maximum sum and maximum worst-channel solutions for unequal channels.
Observation station 3 | Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis: Repeat unload/reload and compare channel distributions, not one best result.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設定陣列目標函數：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Set an array objective: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「輸出變亮一定表示位置更準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「總功率最大即每通道都最佳」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Higher output always means better position" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Maximum total power means every channel is optimum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 光纖陣列被動對準：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Passive alignment of fiber arrays: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 被動對準依靠機械基準與統計容差。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Passive alignment depends on datums and statistical tolerances. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：被動對準依靠機械基準與統計容差。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測裝配後分布並与耦合容差窗口比較。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Passive alignment depends on datums and statistical tolerances. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare assembly distributions with coupling tolerance windows. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測裝配後分布並与耦合容差窗口比較」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare assembly distributions with coupling tolerance windows, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
