guides.title: Intel Foveros 封裝案例：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Intel Foveros packaging case study: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「名稱與版本：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。Foveros 平台有不同整合路線，不能把所有名稱都當成同一 Cu-Cu 接合結構。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Names and revisions: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Foveros includes different integration routes; not every name denotes the same Cu-Cu bond structure. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜名稱與版本：模型與設計：按官方日期將 Foveros-S、R 和 Direct 3D 分列，區分已提供與規劃中。
觀察站 2｜熱耦合：模型與設計：比較總功率相同的三種負載分布，保存每層最高溫。
觀察站 3｜證據化評比：量測與判別：交付功耗、頻寬、熱與測試的比較表，標註來源與假設。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Names and revisions: model and design: List S, R and Direct 3D by official revision, distinguishing available and planned offerings.
Observation station 2 | Thermal coupling: model and design: Compare three equal-total-power distributions and retain per-tier maxima.
Observation station 3 | Evidence-based comparison: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver a power/bandwidth/thermal/test comparison with sources and assumptions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「熱耦合：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「證據化評比：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Thermal coupling: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Evidence-based comparison: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：所有 Foveros 變體都具有完全相同的接合材料和架構。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：所有 Foveros 變體都具有完全相同的接合材料和架構。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Every Foveros variant has identical bonding material and architecture. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.concept: 先用「辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界」建立判讀邊界。裸矽整備處理基板本體；薄膜 CMP 還須保護已形成的材料與圖案。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP to define the interpretation boundary. Bare-wafer finishing shapes the substrate; film CMP must also preserve existing layers and patterns. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界：觀察「厚度達標」與「保留薄膜達標」是否指向不同的量測。
觀察站 2｜分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動：比較材料容易反應但接觸不良，以及接觸充分但漿料狀態不合適的兩種情境。
觀察站 3｜整合晶圓放行與異常處置：確認「尚無證據」沒有被寫成「已證明合格」，不同量測仍保留其基準。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP: Notice whether target wafer thickness and target remaining film require different measurements.
Observation station 2 | Separate pad, slurry and relative motion: Compare a reactive surface with poor contact against good contact with unsuitable slurry condition.
Observation station 3 | Integrate wafer release and disposition: Ensure missing evidence is not recorded as demonstrated compliance and each measurement retains its reference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合晶圓放行與異常處置」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate pad, slurry and relative motion: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integrate wafer release and disposition to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把金屬 CMP 的選擇性直接當成裸矽拋光規格，先退回材料清單重新界定。
把所有變化歸因於轉速會忽略墊面或漿料；重新建立一因一變的比較。

pitfallsEn: If metal-CMP selectivity is treated as a bare-silicon specification, revisit the material inventory.
Attributing every change to speed ignores the pad or slurry; restore a one-factor comparison.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify crystal orientation to define the interpretation boundary. Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識晶向：檢查結果是否能支持「晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify crystal orientation: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Measure total thickness variation: Check whether the evidence supports: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release a slicing lot: Check whether the evidence supports: Release requires thickness, damage, edge and traceability evidence together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「總厚度變異」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure total thickness variation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release a slicing lot to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨識晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「總厚度變異」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify crystal orientation and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 絕緣層上覆矽晶圓製造：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon-on-insulator wafer fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨認三層結構」建立判讀邊界。頂矽、埋氧與支撐晶圓分別承擔不同功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify the three-layer stack to define the interpretation boundary. Top silicon, buried oxide and handle wafer have different roles. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨認三層結構：檢查結果是否能支持「頂矽、埋氧與支撐晶圓分別承擔不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜頂矽厚度圖：檢查結果是否能支持「厚度非均勻可能轉成元件臨界電壓變異。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜SOI 放行矩陣：檢查結果是否能支持「隔離、薄層均勻、鍵合與熱管理需共同審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify the three-layer stack: Check whether the evidence supports: Top silicon, buried oxide and handle wafer have different roles. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Map top-silicon thickness: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness nonuniformity can translate into threshold-voltage variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the SOI stack: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation, layer uniformity, bonding and thermal behavior require joint review. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「頂矽厚度圖」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「SOI 放行矩陣」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map top-silicon thickness: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the SOI stack to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨認三層結構」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「頂矽厚度圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify the three-layer stack and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map top-silicon thickness and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「分辨成長與沉積」建立判讀邊界。熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate growth and deposition to define the interpretation boundary. Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分辨成長與沉積：檢查結果是否能支持「熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜橢偏膜厚：檢查結果是否能支持「光學膜厚反演需要折射率與堆疊假設。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜閘氧驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「厚度圖、介面、漏電與可靠度缺一不可。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate growth and deposition: Check whether the evidence supports: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Interpret ellipsometric thickness: Check whether the evidence supports: Optical thickness extraction requires index and stack assumptions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the gate oxide: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs thickness mapping, interface quality, leakage and reliability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「橢偏膜厚」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「閘氧驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Interpret ellipsometric thickness: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the gate oxide to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「分辨成長與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「橢偏膜厚」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate growth and deposition and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret ellipsometric thickness and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 金屬閘極功函數工程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Metal-gate work-function engineering: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義真空功函數」建立判讀邊界。金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define vacuum work function to define the interpretation boundary. Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義真空功函數：檢查結果是否能支持「金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜區域保護層：檢查結果是否能支持「選擇處理一種元件時需保護另一種閘堆疊。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜金屬閘極驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define vacuum work function: Check whether the evidence supports: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Plan regional protection: Check whether the evidence supports: Processing one device polarity requires protecting the other stack. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the metal gate: Check whether the evidence supports: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「區域保護層」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「金屬閘極驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Plan regional protection: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the metal gate to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「定義真空功函數」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「區域保護層」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define vacuum work function and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for plan regional protection and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 雷射尖峰退火：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Laser spike annealing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「毫秒與奈秒」建立判讀邊界。不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes to define the interpretation boundary. Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜毫秒與奈秒：檢查結果是否能支持「不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜摻雜活化：檢查結果是否能支持「短熱歷程可改變活化與擴散的相對程度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜雷射退火審查：檢查結果是否能支持「活化收益需與熱峰值、均勻性及下層相容性一起評估。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes: Check whether the evidence supports: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Evaluate dopant activation: Check whether the evidence supports: Short thermal histories change the balance between activation and diffusion. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review laser-anneal evidence: Check whether the evidence supports: Assess activation gain with thermal peaks, uniformity and buried-layer compatibility. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「摻雜活化」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「雷射退火審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Evaluate dopant activation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review laser-anneal evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「毫秒與奈秒」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「摻雜活化」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for evaluate dopant activation and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Shallow-trench isolation fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「主動區邊界」建立判讀邊界。隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw active-area boundaries to define the interpretation boundary. Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜主動區邊界：檢查結果是否能支持「隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜底部與側壁成長：檢查結果是否能支持「不均勻成長可能造成入口先封閉。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜STI 整合放行：檢查結果是否能支持「填充、平坦、漏電與通道應力需共同符合要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw active-area boundaries: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare bottom and sidewall growth: Check whether the evidence supports: Uneven growth can close the opening prematurely. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept STI integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Fill, planarity, leakage and channel stress require joint acceptance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「底部與側壁成長」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「STI 整合放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare bottom and sidewall growth: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept STI integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「主動區邊界」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「底部與側壁成長」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw active-area boundaries and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare bottom and sidewall growth and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 應變矽通道整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Strained-silicon channel integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「應力與應變」建立判讀邊界。應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate stress and strain to define the interpretation boundary. Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜應力與應變：檢查結果是否能支持「應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜拉曼位移：檢查結果是否能支持「峰位變化也需排除溫度及成分影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜應變整合結論：檢查結果是否能支持「需將輸運收益與缺陷、漏電及版圖變異一起呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate stress and strain: Check whether the evidence supports: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Interpret Raman shifts: Check whether the evidence supports: Peak shifts require separating temperature and composition effects. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review strain integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Report transport gains with defects, leakage and layout variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「拉曼位移」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「應變整合結論」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Interpret Raman shifts: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review strain integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「應力與應變」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「拉曼位移」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate stress and strain and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret raman shifts and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate power and signals: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Place rail contacts: Check whether the evidence supports: Vias must land reliably on rails while preserving surrounding isolation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release buried-rail integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Electrical, isolation, thermal compatibility and routability all need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate resistance and resistivity: Check whether the evidence supports: Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Lay out a TLM array: Check whether the evidence supports: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate resistance and resistivity and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 光阻烘烤與顯影控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Photoresist bake and development control: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「軟烤與 PEB」建立判讀邊界。除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate softbake and PEB to define the interpretation boundary. Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜軟烤與 PEB：檢查結果是否能支持「除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜正負型溶解：檢查結果是否能支持「顯影保留區由材料反應與顯影化學共同決定。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜光阻圖案交接：檢查結果是否能支持「線寬、輪廓、殘膠及薄膜損失需共同符合要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate softbake and PEB: Check whether the evidence supports: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Separate positive and negative tone: Check whether the evidence supports: Remaining regions depend on both resist chemistry and developer. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the resist pattern: Check whether the evidence supports: Width, profile, scum and retained-film loss must jointly meet requirements. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「正負型溶解」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「光阻圖案交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate positive and negative tone: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the resist pattern to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「軟烤與 PEB」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「正負型溶解」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate softbake and peb and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate positive and negative tone and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 光罩電子束寫入：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Electron-beam mask writing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「將晶圓目標依縮小倍率轉成光罩座標」建立判讀邊界。光罩與晶圓座標必須註明尺度。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Convert wafer targets into mask coordinates using reduction to define the interpretation boundary. Mask and wafer coordinates require explicit scales. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜將晶圓目標依縮小倍率轉成光罩座標：光罩與晶圓座標必須註明尺度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜畫出前向與背向散射的作用範圍：鄰近效應包含不同空間尺度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付資料、曝光與量測的完整鏈結：追溯性讓異常能回到對應來源。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Convert wafer targets into mask coordinates using reduction: Mask and wafer coordinates require explicit scales. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Sketch forward- and backscatter ranges: Proximity effects span different spatial scales. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a linked data-writing-metrology record: Traceability links anomalies to their sources. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「畫出前向與背向散射的作用範圍」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付資料、曝光與量測的完整鏈結」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Sketch forward- and backscatter ranges: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a linked data-writing-metrology record to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「把晶圓尺寸直接當作光罩尺寸。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「平均劑量相同即可忽略拼接。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Use wafer dimensions directly as mask dimensions.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Equal mean dose makes stitching irrelevant.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義目標輪廓與可修改的光罩區：反問題需先界定設計自由度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

guides.title: 導向自組裝圖案化：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Directed self-assembly patterning: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分開區塊相分離與宏觀混合」建立判讀邊界。共價連接限制兩區塊完全分離。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish microphase separation from macroscopic mixing to define the interpretation boundary. Covalent linkage prevents complete block separation. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分開區塊相分離與宏觀混合：共價連接限制兩區塊完全分離。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜將位錯、橋接與缺失線分開：不同缺陷代表不同失敗機制。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提交模板、材料與缺陷證據鏈：可整合性需要位置、缺陷與轉移共同證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish microphase separation from macroscopic mixing: Covalent linkage prevents complete block separation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Separate dislocations, bridges and missing lines: Different defect classes indicate different failure mechanisms. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a guide–material–defect evidence chain: Integrability needs combined placement, defect and transfer evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「將位錯、橋接與缺失線分開」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交模板、材料與缺陷證據鏈」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate dislocations, bridges and missing lines: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a guide–material–defect evidence chain to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「自組裝完全不需要任何定位模板。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「單張顯微照片足以證明零缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Self-assembly needs no placement template.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "One micrograph proves zero defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw electrons, ions and neutral radicals to define the interpretation boundary. Particle populations have different energies and directionality. procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出電子、離子與中性自由基：粒子族群具有不同能量與方向性。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

觀察站 3｜交付速率、輪廓、選擇性與損傷報告：RIE 合格判準必須是多維度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw electrons, ions and neutral radicals: Particle populations have different energies and directionality. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "RIE is purely physical bombardment.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

guides.title: 金屬有機化學氣相沉積：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Metal-organic chemical vapor deposition: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出金屬有機源到晶體薄膜的路徑」建立判讀邊界。氣相分解與表面反應不是同一階段。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Trace metal-organic sources into crystalline films to define the interpretation boundary. Gas decomposition and surface reaction are different stages. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出金屬有機源到晶體薄膜的路徑：氣相分解與表面反應不是同一階段。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜用 XRD 概念分開晶格常數與應變：峰位改變可能有多種來源。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付反應器、結構與性能的證據鏈：可重現成長需要完整條件與量測範圍。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Trace metal-organic sources into crystalline films: Gas decomposition and surface reaction are different stages. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Use XRD concepts to distinguish lattice parameter and strain: Peak shifts can have multiple origins. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver reactor, structure and performance evidence: Reproducible growth needs complete conditions and measurement scope. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「用 XRD 概念分開晶格常數與應變」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付反應器、結構與性能的證據鏈」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Use XRD concepts to distinguish lattice parameter and strain: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver reactor, structure and performance evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「氣相混合均勻就能保證晶體完全無缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「發光強度相同就代表晶體品質完全相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Uniform gas mixing guarantees defect-free crystals.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Equal emission intensity proves identical crystal quality.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 銅雙鑲嵌互連：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Copper dual-damascene interconnects: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽」建立判讀邊界。垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a via and trench between metal levels to define the interpretation boundary. Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽：垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充：超共形填充可避免過早封口。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查：局部製程合格仍需跨層功能驗證。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a via and trench between metal levels: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: Superconformal fill can avoid premature closure. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a two-level RC and failure review: Local process acceptance still needs cross-layer functional validation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a two-level RC and failure review to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「雙鑲嵌就是直接蝕刻厚銅形成所有線孔。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「表面平坦可排除內部空洞。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Dual damascene directly etches thick copper into all lines and vias.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A planar surface rules out internal voids.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 阻障層與種子層沉積：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Barrier and seed-layer deposition: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出介電層、阻障、種子與銅主體」建立判讀邊界。不同層負責不同物理功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw dielectric, barrier, seed and bulk copper to define the interpretation boundary. Different layers serve different physical functions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出介電層、阻障、種子與銅主體：不同層負責不同物理功能。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜以片電阻地圖檢查種子連續性：低平均電阻仍可能伴隨局部斷點。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付覆蓋、導通、擴散與附著評審：阻障種子整合需要四類證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw dielectric, barrier, seed and bulk copper: Different layers serve different physical functions. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Map sheet resistance to assess seed continuity: Low mean resistance can coexist with local discontinuities. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review coverage, continuity, diffusion and adhesion: Barrier–seed integration needs four classes of evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「以片電阻地圖檢查種子連續性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付覆蓋、導通、擴散與附著評審」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map sheet resistance to assess seed continuity: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review coverage, continuity, diffusion and adhesion to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「有種子層就不需要任何擴散阻障。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「種子表面氧化不會影響電鍍。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "A seed layer eliminates all need for a diffusion barrier.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Seed oxidation cannot affect plating.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw anode, cathode and electrolyte current paths to define the interpretation boundary. Electrons and ions travel through different paths. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出陽極、陰極與電解液的電流路徑：電子與離子在不同路徑傳輸。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜繪製共形填充與自底向上填充：底部較快成長可減少封口空洞。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付電荷、截面與電性一致性報告：填孔成功需要多種相互支持的證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw anode, cathode and electrolyte current paths: Electrons and ions travel through different paths. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Sketch conformal and bottom-up filling: Faster bottom growth can reduce pinch-off voids. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver charge, cross-section and electrical consistency: Successful fill needs mutually supporting evidence types. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「繪製共形填充與自底向上填充」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付電荷、截面與電性一致性報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Sketch conformal and bottom-up filling: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver charge, cross-section and electrical consistency to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「通過多少電荷就保證全部都變成銅。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「孔口沉積最快就是最佳填孔。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "All passed charge is guaranteed to become copper.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Fastest opening deposition is the best fill.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use Reliability report: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜相態與電阻：建立模型：電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Phase and resistance: construct and analyze: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture; Read bias should avoid reheating the state.
Observation station 2 | Confined active volume: construct and analyze: Surrounding material need not transform each cycle; Active thermal volume can be smaller than electrode area.

evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Confined active volume: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Array endurance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.concept: 先用「晶相與鐵電性：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Phase and ferroelectricity: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜晶相與鐵電性：建立模型：氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相；X 光相峰重疊可能使相判讀不唯一。
觀察站 2｜氧交換介面：建立模型：改變氧環境可能同時改變晶相和缺陷；氧移動可能伴隨循環歷史效應。
觀察站 3｜整合證據：故障判讀與驗證：研究最佳值需連同條件與分布閱讀；極化與漏電需在同條件下比較。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Phase and ferroelectricity: construct and analyze: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase; Overlapping diffraction peaks can obscure phase identity.
Observation station 2 | Oxygen-exchange interfaces: construct and analyze: Oxygen conditions can alter both phase and defects; Oxygen migration can depend on cycling history.
Observation station 3 | Integration evidence: diagnose and verify: Research best values must be read with conditions and distributions; Compare polarization and leakage under matching conditions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「氧交換介面：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合證據：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Oxygen-exchange interfaces: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration evidence: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「只量化學成分就宣稱鐵電性」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「所有氧空缺減少都必然改善全部性能」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Claiming ferroelectricity from composition alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming fewer oxygen vacancies improve every property", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Absorption and multiplication: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜吸收與倍增：建立模型：光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求；電子和電洞游離率可能不同。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Absorption and multiplication: construct and analyze: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements; Electron and hole ionization rates can differ.
Observation station 2 | Bandwidth limits: construct and analyze: The slowest dynamic process limits response; Avalanche buildup creates gain-bandwidth tradeoffs.
Observation station 3 | Detection system: diagnose and verify: Optimal gain depends on the complete noise budget; Amplifier input capacitance affects optimal configuration.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Bandwidth limits: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.

guides.title: 晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer thin-film ellipsometry: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「p/s 偏振：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：偏振定義需相對於入射平面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with p/s polarization: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Polarization definitions are relative to incidence plane. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜p/s 偏振：建立模型：偏振定義需相對於入射平面；偏振器零點誤差會混入相位。
觀察站 2｜色散模型：建立模型：透明模型不能無條件延伸到吸收能帶；色散模型需檢查物理一致性。
觀察站 3｜報告與限制：故障判讀與驗證：厚度結果是條件化的模型推論；參數信賴區間應包含模型限制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | p/s polarization: construct and analyze: Polarization definitions are relative to incidence plane; Polarizer-zero errors contaminate phase.
Observation station 2 | Dispersion model: construct and analyze: Transparent models cannot be extended blindly into absorption; Dispersion models require physical-consistency checks.
Observation station 3 | Report and limits: diagnose and verify: Thickness is a model-conditioned inference; Confidence reporting should include model limitations.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「色散模型：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「報告與限制：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Dispersion model: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Report and limits: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把水平與垂直永遠當 p 和 s」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「同一透明模型適用所有波長」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating horizontal/vertical as universally p/s", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Applying one transparency model at every wavelength", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：CPU 管線與分支預測

guides.concept: 以指令相依、投機與精確提交連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect instruction dependencies, speculation and precise retirement through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ISA 與微架構」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同指令集可用不同管線實作。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「管線深度」的資料、控制與時間關係。深管線可能提高時脈卻增加復原代價。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「固定程式比較延遲與週期數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「暫存器重新命名」的資料、控制與時間關係。重新命名消除名稱相依而非真資料相依。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「拆分 WAR、WAW 與 RAW。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「目標預測」的資料、控制與時間關係。方向正確仍可能得到錯誤目標。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分開記錄方向與目標命中。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「記憶體順序」的資料、控制與時間關係。投機讀取須驗證與先前寫入相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立相同位址的讀寫時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「架構驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。效能改善不能犧牲可見程式語義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比對提交軌跡與參考結果。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for isa and microarchitecture. The same ISA permits different pipelines. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for pipeline depth. Deeper pipelines may raise clock and recovery cost. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare latency and cycle counts for one program. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for register renaming. Renaming removes name, not true data dependencies. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate WAR, WAW and RAW cases. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for target prediction. Correct direction may still have a wrong target. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Count direction and target hits separately. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for memory ordering. Speculative loads require checks against older stores. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Construct same-address load/store timing. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for architecture acceptance. Speedups must preserve visible program semantics. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare retirement traces with reference results. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「量測基準」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「固定輸入與暖機再比較。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「架構驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「效能改善不能犧牲可見程式語義。」。
提交「架構驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比對提交軌跡與參考結果。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit measurement baseline input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit architecture acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit architecture acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：寬解碼保證所有程式 CPI 同比下降。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Wider decode guarantees proportional CPI reduction. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace a read followed by a write. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for directory tracking. Directories track sharers to reduce broadcasts. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare full bitmaps and limited pointers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for true sharing. Padding cannot remove genuine shared-write contention. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Distinguish shared locks from separate counters. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for protocol invariants. Single-writer and latest-data are separate invariants. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check both invariants in each modeled state. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for scalability. More cores may exhaust links or directories first. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Sweep core count and sharing fraction separately. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「交通成本」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「以本課算例加上假想標頭。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「擴展性」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「核心數增加可能先耗盡互連或目錄資源。」。
提交「擴展性」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分別掃描核心數與共享比例。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit traffic costs input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit scalability two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit scalability input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：填補變數會消除所有真共享。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Padding eliminates all true sharing. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.concept: 以SIMT 執行、資料重用與資源佔用連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect simt execution, reuse and resource occupancy through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「執行階層」的資料、控制與時間關係。執行緒組成區塊，區塊映射到 SM。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫 grid、block 與 SM 的對應。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「區塊獨立」的資料、控制與時間關係。一般區塊不能假設其他區塊已執行。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「打亂區塊順序核對結果。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Bank 衝突」的資料、控制與時間關係。不同位址可能映射同一 bank。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較轉置前後的 bank 索引。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「屏障一致」的資料、控制與時間關係。需要參與的執行緒須遵守屏障契約。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對分支內屏障的路徑。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「算術強度」的資料、控制與時間關係。每位元組工作量限制可達運算率。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「重算本課向量頻寬上界。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「CPU 對照」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同輸入與語義才能比較兩架構。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對結果、傳輸與完整耗時。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for execution hierarchy. Threads form blocks mapped to SMs. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Map grid, blocks and SMs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for block independence. Ordinary blocks cannot assume others have run. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Shuffle block order and check results. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for bank conflicts. Different addresses can map to one bank. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare bank indices before and after transpose. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for barrier convergence. Required threads must obey barrier participation. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit barrier paths inside branches. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for arithmetic intensity. Work per byte bounds compute throughput. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Recalculate the vector bandwidth bound. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for cpu reference. Architectures need matching inputs and semantics. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check results, transfers and total time. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「數值誤差」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較絕對與相對誤差。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「CPU 對照」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「相同輸入與語義才能比較兩架構。」。
提交「CPU 對照」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對結果、傳輸與完整耗時。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit numerical error input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit cpu reference two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit cpu reference input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：原子操作會消除全部資料相依。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

guides.concept: 以脈動陣列、混合精度與編譯映射連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect systolic arrays, mixed precision and compiler mapping through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「張量維度」的資料、控制與時間關係。矩陣相乘的內維度必須相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對 M×K 與 K×N 形狀。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「資料平鋪」的資料、控制與時間關係。維度不整除會產生邊緣空槽。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較整齊與零補齊矩陣。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「雙緩衝」的資料、控制與時間關係。載入與運算重疊需要足夠緩衝。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較串列與重疊時程。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「累加精度」的資料、控制與時間關係。低精度輸入可配較高精度累加。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤長點積的捨入誤差。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「編譯映射」的資料、控制與時間關係。融合可減少交通但增加局部資源。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較融合前後暫存量。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「精度驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。速度提升需同時核對任務品質。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較基準誤差與吞吐變化。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for tensor dimensions. Matrix inner dimensions must agree. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check M×K and K×N shapes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for data tiling. Nondivisible dimensions create edge waste. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare aligned and padded matrices. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for double buffering. Load/compute overlap needs sufficient buffering. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare serial and overlapping schedules. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for accumulation precision. Low-precision inputs may use wider accumulation. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace rounding in a long dot product. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for compiler mapping. Fusion saves traffic but consumes local resources. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare temporary storage before and after fusion. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for accuracy acceptance. Speedups require task-quality checks. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare reference error and throughput changes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「輸入管線」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分離讀取、轉換與運算耗時。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「精度驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「速度提升需同時核對任務品質。」。
提交「精度驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較基準誤差與吞吐變化。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit input pipeline input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit accuracy acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit accuracy acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：峰值 FLOP/s 可直接當作端到端訓練吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect hls, streaming pipelines and finite resource mapping through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「功能契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「介面握手」的資料、控制與時間關係。有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「展開迴圈」的資料、控制與時間關係。展開複製運算資源但仍受供料限制。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較倍增運算器與埠數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「FIFO 深度」的資料、控制與時間關係。深度需吸收突發及相位差。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤每週期佔用峰值。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「C/RTL 共模擬」的資料、控制與時間關係。共模擬驗證指定輸入而非所有情境。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「加入邊界長度與回壓。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「端到端比較」的資料、控制與時間關係。DMA 與主機整理可能主導耗時。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「把資料傳輸納入總帳。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for functional contract. Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Define input, output and completion. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for interface handshake. Valid and ready jointly determine transfers. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for loop unrolling. Unrolling duplicates compute but remains feed-limited. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare compute duplication and port count. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for fifo depth. Depth absorbs bursts and phase mismatch. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace peak cycle-by-cycle occupancy. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for c/rtl cosimulation. Cosimulation validates tested inputs, not all cases. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Add boundary lengths and backpressure. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for end-to-end comparison. DMA and host preparation can dominate runtime. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Include transfers in the total budget. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「時序裕量」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較目標與實際 critical path。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「端到端比較」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「DMA 與主機整理可能主導耗時。」。
提交「端到端比較」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「把資料傳輸納入總帳。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit timing margin input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit end-to-end comparison two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit end-to-end comparison input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Memory ports cease to matter after loop unrolling. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：片上網路路由器
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Network-on-chip routers
guides.concept: 以Flit、虛擬通道與可證明路由連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect flits, virtual channels and verifiable routing through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「拓撲座標」的資料、控制與時間關係。網格連線決定跳數與切割頻寬。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「端點介面」的資料、控制與時間關係。端點需組包、拆包並保留語義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對封包與原始請求對應。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「交換仲裁」的資料、控制與時間關係。公平性與最大吞吐是不同目標。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較輪詢與固定優先權。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「隊頭阻塞」的資料、控制與時間關係。首包等待可能阻止後方可行封包。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「構造不同目的地的佇列。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「注入率」的資料、控制與時間關係。高於瓶頸服務率會積累等待。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「掃描注入率及平均延遲。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「正確性驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。無丟包不代表無重複或順序正確。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查序號、計數與交付順序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for topology coordinates. Mesh links determine hops and bisection bandwidth. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw a 4×4 mesh and count farthest hops. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for endpoint interface. Endpoints packetize and reassemble semantic messages. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Match packets to original requests. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for switch arbitration. Fairness and maximum throughput differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare round-robin and fixed priority. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for head-of-line blocking. A blocked head can stall feasible followers. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Construct queues with different destinations. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for injection rate. Injection above bottleneck service builds queues. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Sweep injection and mean latency. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for correctness acceptance. No loss does not imply no duplication or correct order. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check sequences, counts and delivery order. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「延遲分解」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「擴充本課空載算例。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「正確性驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「無丟包不代表無重複或順序正確。」。
提交「正確性驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「檢查序號、計數與交付順序。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit latency breakdown input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit correctness acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit correctness acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：鏈路峰值可直接當作全部端點吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Peak link rate equals total endpoint throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
