pitfalls: DKIM 通過永遠等於與可見 From 對齊。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: DKIM pass always means alignment with visible From. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：安全網頁應用程式防護
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Web-application protection systems
guides.concept: 以應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「應用資產」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先界定資料與動作，才可驗證保護要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「信任邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「輸入格式」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正規化與解析次序可能改變檢查結果。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「規則範圍」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「False positive」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：合法變體誤攔應以業務案例重現。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較有與沒有來源端授權檢查的本地模型。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Rate limiting」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「原站保護」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：入口防護需避免未受控旁路直達原站。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定流量，只改規則數量與處理成本。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「回應資料」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「檢測與封鎖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先觀察可協助調校，但不等於已阻止流量。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「規則版本」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「防護驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正常、邊界與合成異常案例均需覆蓋。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「應用資產」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around application assets, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat trust boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around input formats, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Normalization/parsing order can change inspection results. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rule scopes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around false positives, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reproduce benign false blocks with business cases. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare local models with/without origin authorization. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rate limiting as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around origin protection, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Ingress protection needs closure of uncontrolled origin bypasses. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix traffic and vary rule count/processing cost. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat response data as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection versus blocking, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation aids tuning but does not imply blocking. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rule versions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around protection acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance covers benign, boundary and synthetic anomaly cases. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat application assets as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「回滾決策」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「防護驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for protection acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect endpoint events, detection evidence and approved response through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around endpoint coverage, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Missing sensors create unobservable regions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary parent-child relationships. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat process events as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around network events, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Connection records need not contain application content. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary parent-child relationships. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat time ordering as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around technique mapping, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: ATT&CK mappings organize observations, not concrete rules. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare evidence gaps with active/offline sensors. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rule data requirements as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around evidence preservation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Maintain provenance/integrity records throughout investigation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign administrative activity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat alert severity as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around sensor health, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Stopped events may indicate sensor failure, not normality. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model service impact after approved endpoint isolation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat privacy minimization as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around response acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Verify detection, decision, approval and recovery end to end. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model service impact after approved endpoint isolation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat endpoint coverage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat timezone and skew as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Compare different name mappings for one subject. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat correlation windows as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around retention, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat query performance as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Source outages need health-event handling. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model storage outage and buffered recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat incident workflow as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Backfill checks missing data, duplicates and original timestamps. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model storage outage and buffered recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat source inventory as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect network visibility, protocol decoding and alert quality through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「觀察點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「鏡像完整性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around observation points, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary mirror placement. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat mirror completeness as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around reassembly assumptions, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reordering and missing packets limit parsable content. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary mirror placement. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat protocol decoding as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around rule conditions, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rules must match fields actually collected. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare flow summaries with complete synthetic protocol records. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat baseline models as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection thresholds, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Lower thresholds can raise recall and false positives. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary encrypted-traffic share. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat low base rates as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around alert correlation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Corroborate alerts with identity, endpoint and timing evidence. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat controlled data as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around blind-spot reporting, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Report unobserved regions rather than claiming complete protection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat observation points as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around remote maintenance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around protocol limitations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Model isolation failure and predefined safe degradation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat event preservation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: This course simulates flow matrices without scanning live OT equipment. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model isolation failure and predefined safe degradation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat ot asset boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「裝置識別」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「唯一憑據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around device identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat unique credentials as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around secure provisioning, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Initial identity must bind the device and owner. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat secret storage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around dtls boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Datagram security still handles reordering/retransmission. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat clock limitations as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around remote attestation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Attestation checks freshness and expected measurements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix algorithms and vary device-clock quality. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat provisioning roles as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around revocation propagation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Offline states delay device receipt of revocation data. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model renewal during offline periods and controlled recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat fleet bursts as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around evidence acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Test uniqueness, freshness, rejection and recovery. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model renewal during offline periods and controlled recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat device identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: This course analyzes authored records without connecting/injecting into vehicles. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model monitor failure and alert-coverage effects. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat vehicle function maps as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect memory protection, remote attestation and secret release through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「威胁模型」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「保護邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around threat models, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat protection boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around measured workloads, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Measurements represent reviewable versions/configurations. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat attesters as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around relying parties, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Relying parties use appraisal results for concrete authorization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare fresh/replayed attestation records. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat freshness as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around reference values, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Approved releases define trusted measurements, not self-declaration. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix evidence and vary trust-policy version. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat secret release as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around rollback limits, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Once-approved old versions may later be prohibited for vulnerabilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat i/o boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around deployment acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Test wrong measurements, stale reports and authorization rejection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat threat models as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「側信道限制」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for side-channel limits. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 證明報告存在便證明其測量值得信任。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: The existence of an attestation report proves its measurements trusted. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Software vulnerability-management workflows
guides.concept: 以弱點風險、相依圖與修補放行串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect vulnerability risk, dependency graphs and patch acceptance with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「資產識別」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for asset identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for prioritization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence, criticality and compensating controls jointly inform priority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Rank anonymous equal-score cases with different exposure. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for change windows. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Availability and risk jointly constrain deployment timing. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare downtime budgets with and without redundancy. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for canary rollout. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A small canary limits impact but may not represent all workloads. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare synthetic canary and full traffic distributions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for patch evidence. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Update-success logs require running-version cross-checks. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare installation records and post-restart versions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for recovery review. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Causes, versions and acceptance evidence must be reconstructable. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Reconstruct a failed batch and rollback decision offline. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「覆蓋分母」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「未知資產不應計入任何風險討論。」為何不成立。
提交「復原回顧」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用離線時間線重現失敗批次與回退決策。」如何辨別它們。
提交「復原回顧」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「復原成功表示不需保留失敗資料。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for coverage denominators; explain why this claim fails: Unknown assets need no risk consideration.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for recovery review; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for recovery review; explain why this claim fails: Successful recovery removes the need to retain failure evidence.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：復原成功表示不需保留失敗資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Successful recovery removes the need to retain failure evidence. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for exercise authority. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Systems, data and response authority are defined before exercises. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for exercise injects. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Injects distinguish expected behavior and uncertain branches. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Design fictional service disruption without attacking systems. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for incident severity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Severity accounts for impact and confidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare high-impact uncertain and low-impact certain cases. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for evidence and recovery. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rapid recovery can overwrite unpreserved evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare sampling-first and restart-first evidence retention. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for communication records. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Communication follows confirmed facts, timing and accountable roles. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Write an anonymous exercise brief with unconfirmed items marked. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for corrective-action tracking. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Actions need owners, deadlines and re-exercise evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Turn a process gap into an observable repeat exercise. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「復盤因果」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「故障後最後一個變更必然是原因。」為何不成立。
提交「修正追蹤」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「將一項流程缺口轉成可觀察的再次演練。」如何辨別它們。
提交「修正追蹤」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「寫下改善建議便等於風險已降低。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for review causality; explain why this claim fails: The last preceding change is necessarily the cause.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for corrective-action tracking; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for corrective-action tracking; explain why this claim fails: Writing a recommendation means risk is reduced.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：寫下改善建議便等於風險已降低。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Writing a recommendation means risk is reduced. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect traceable, intact and reproducible digital evidence with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「合法與任務範圍」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：證據接觸需限定資料、目的與處理授權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for authority and scope. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence access is bounded by data, purpose and authority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for collection alteration. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Collection tools may themselves change observed state. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: List logs and timestamps a toy collector may change. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for hash integrity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Cryptographic hashes detect changes, not content truth. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Change one bit in a self-made copy and compare digests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for files and sectors. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Allocated files and unallocated regions differ. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare directory entries with byte ranges in a self-made image. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for collection throughput. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Read/write bottlenecks and verification passes set duration. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate collection and verification time bounds. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for retention and deletion. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retention, access and compliance requirements are managed separately. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify retention, expiry and exceptions in a fictional workflow. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「報告重現」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只有截圖即可完整重現分析。」為何不成立。
提交「儲存與刪除」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在假想流程列出儲存、到期及例外批准。」如何辨別它們。
提交「儲存與刪除」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「證據越多儲存越久永遠越好。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for report reproduction; explain why this claim fails: Screenshots alone fully reproduce analysis.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for retention and deletion; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for retention and deletion; explain why this claim fails: Keeping more evidence forever is always better.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：證據越多儲存越久永遠越好。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Keeping more evidence forever is always better. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect data minimization and privacy–utility trade-offs with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「用途邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for purpose boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Principle: Collectors, analysts and publishers can have different privileges. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark fields visible at each layer of an anonymous architecture. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for aggregation choices. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare bias and smallest groups under different binning. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare error distributions with synthetic sampling. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for bias checks. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Overall utility can hide poor minority-group errors. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Report synthetic-group errors and missingness separately. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Principle: Privacy, error and purpose jointly define acceptable performance. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「再現與稽核」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「重現必須向所有人公開原始個資。」為何不成立。

evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for reproduction and audit; explain why this claim fails: Reproduction requires sharing personal data with everyone.

Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for utility decisions; explain why this claim fails: The smallest ε necessarily yields the best product.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for federation boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Local data retention does not prevent update or model leakage. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace raw data, updates and global-model flows. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for local backpropagation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The chain rule propagates local loss gradients to parameters. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Check one tiny-network gradient with finite differences. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for non-iid data. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Label and feature shifts change aggregate gradient direction. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare gradient angles for two synthetic clients. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for secure aggregation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Canceling masks hide individual updates while revealing allowed aggregates. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Verify mask cancellation with three toy vectors. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for model validation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Global and client tests must avoid overlapping training data. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build client-isolated and time-isolated synthetic tests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for delivery versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Released models link participation policies and privacy accounting. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Create a personal-data-free toy model card and settings digest. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「收斂診斷」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「損失升高只有學習率過高一個原因。」為何不成立。
提交「交付版本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「產生無個資的玩具模型卡與設定摘要。」如何辨別它們。
提交「交付版本」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「保留最終權重便足以稽核聯邦訓練。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for convergence diagnosis; explain why this claim fails: Higher loss can only mean an excessive learning rate.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for delivery versions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for delivery versions; explain why this claim fails: Final weights suffice to audit federated training.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：保留最終權重便足以稽核聯邦訓練。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Final weights suffice to audit federated training. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

Principle: Share privacy needs adequate, unreused randomness. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Analyze reused-randomness correlations symbolically. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Principle: Local share products generally miss cross-share terms. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. procedure: 先觀察師傅的「來源可用」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：來源需有版本、授權與可引用位置。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「資料許可權」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：檢索候選需在生成前依使用者許可權過濾。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用假資料角色檢查私有切片不進提示。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「再排序模型」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：交叉編碼器比較查詢與檔案對，成本隨候選數增加。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫雙塔與交叉編碼器的計算路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「提示信任」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：來源內容是資料，不能自動提升為系統指令。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自製含無害錯誤指示的檔案驗證隔離。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

先觀察師傅的「迴歸題集」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：題集需包含矛盾、許可權、未知與數值邊界。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自製資料建立可重算的八題題集。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for source usability. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sources need versions, rights and citeable locations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for data permissions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Candidates are permission-filtered before generation. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Verify fictional private chunks never enter unauthorized prompts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for reranking models. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Cross-encoders score query-document pairs with candidate-dependent cost. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw dual-encoder and cross-encoder computation paths. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for prompt trust. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Source content is data, not automatically system authority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Test separation using self-made harmless misleading text. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for citation alignment. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Each claim maps to supporting passages and conditions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Check each synthetic claim against the manual. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for regression queries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tests include contradictions, permissions, unknowns and numeric boundaries. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build eight reproducible questions from self-made data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「延遲拆解」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只看生成速度便代表整體服務速度。」為何不成立。
提交「迴歸題集」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自製資料建立可重算的八題題集。」如何辨別它們。
提交「迴歸題集」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只測容易回答問題即可驗收 RAG。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for latency decomposition; explain why this claim fails: Generation speed equals total service speed.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for regression queries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for regression queries; explain why this claim fails: Easy questions alone validate RAG.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：只測容易回答問題即可驗收 RAG。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Easy questions alone validate RAG. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect transformers, kv caches and inference scheduling with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「參數與啟用」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：權重、啟用與快取有不同生命週期。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫單請求與多請求的記憶體共享範圍。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「前饋層」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：逐 token 非線性變換可主導參數與運算量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「計算玩具 d×4d×d 兩層矩陣維度。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「因果遮罩」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：自迴歸 token 不能讀取尚未生成的未來位置。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫三 token 下三角可見矩陣。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

先觀察師傅的「Decode」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：decode 每步新增 token，常受權重讀取與快取存取約束。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用本地假模型分開計時 prefill 與 decode。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「連續批次」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：動態合批提高利用率但需處理請求生命週期。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「模擬短長請求加入退出的排程表。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「服務驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：首 token、每 token、尾延遲與品質應一起報告。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「建立合成請求矩陣並保留失敗案例。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for parameters and activations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Weights, activations and caches have different lifetimes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw memory sharing for one and multiple requests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for feed-forward layers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Per-token nonlinear transformations can dominate parameters and compute. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate dimensions of a toy d-to-4d-to-d block. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for causal masks. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Autoregressive tokens cannot read future positions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw a three-token lower-triangular visibility matrix. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for decode. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Decode appends tokens and can be limited by weight and cache access. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Time prefill and decode separately with a local toy model. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for continuous batching. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Dynamic batching improves utilization while tracking request lifecycles. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Simulate short and long request arrivals and exits. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for service acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: First-token, per-token, tail latency and quality are reported together. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build a synthetic request matrix and retain failures. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「生成策略」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「temperature=0 就保證所有事實正確。」為何不成立。
提交「服務驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「建立合成請求矩陣並保留失敗案例。」如何辨別它們。
提交「服務驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只報每秒 token 就證明服務適合所有使用者。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for generation policies; explain why this claim fails: Temperature zero guarantees factual correctness.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for service acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for service acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Tokens per second alone proves universal service suitability.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：只報每秒 token 就證明服務適合所有使用者。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Tokens per second alone proves universal service suitability. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for retention policies; explain why this claim fails: Deleting old data never affects old-model reproduction.

Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for delivery acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Unzipping proves research reproducibility.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：模型監測與漂移偵測
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Model monitoring and drift detection
guides.concept: 以資料漂移、品質與模型效能分離串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect separation of data drift, quality and model performance with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「基準版本」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：比較需固定基準資料、時間窗與模型版本。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「建立自製監測資料的版本表。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

先觀察師傅的「效應量」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：大樣本的小差異可能顯著但不重要。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「同時報告假想差異、區間與影響量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for reference versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Comparisons pin reference data, windows and model versions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build versions for self-made monitoring data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for concept drift. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: P(y∣x) can change while the input distribution remains fixed. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Keep toy input distributions and change labeling rules. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for effect size. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Small differences in large samples can be significant yet immaterial. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Report differences, intervals and effect sizes together. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for classification metrics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Precision, recall and prevalence affect error costs. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate a synthetic confusion matrix beyond accuracy. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for alert suppression. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Deduplication and persistence reduce noise but may delay detection. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare one-window and three-window toy alerts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for monitoring acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance tests misses, false alarms and action value. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare two monitoring policies on self-made fixed cases. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「再訓練門檻」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「一檢測到 drift 就必須立即上線重訓模型。」為何不成立。
提交「監測驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自製固定題集比較兩種監測策略。」如何辨別它們。
提交「監測驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「告警越多就表示監測越有效。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for retraining gates; explain why this claim fails: Every drift alert requires immediate model release.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for monitoring acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for monitoring acceptance; explain why this claim fails: More alerts mean more effective monitoring.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：告警越多就表示監測越有效。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: More alerts mean more effective monitoring. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

procedure: 先觀察師傅的「域分解」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for domain decomposition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for boundary conditions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical and interdomain boundaries are handled differently. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark both boundary types on a toy diffusion grid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for nonblocking completion. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Buffers may remain in use after nonblocking calls return. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark buffer reuse only after completion on a toy timeline. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for reduction numerics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Nonassociative floating addition makes reduction order affect low bits. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare two orders with large, small and negative-large values. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for strong/weak scaling. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fixed total and per-rank problem sizes are different tests. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate both efficiencies from synthetic timings. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for result validation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Parallel results compare with serial, small-scale and conserved constraints. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate mass and errors on a self-made diffusion grid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「檢查點一致」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「每 rank 任意時刻各自存檔就能正確恢復。」為何不成立。
提交「結果驗證」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算自製小擴散網格的質量與誤差。」如何辨別它們。
提交「結果驗證」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「能用更多 rank 就證明結果更準確。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for checkpoint consistency; explain why this claim fails: Arbitrary independent rank saves always restore correctly.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for result validation; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for result validation; explain why this claim fails: More ranks prove more accurate results.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：能用更多 rank 就證明結果更準確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: More ranks prove more accurate results. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect fluid pdes, data assimilation and ensemble forecasts with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「預報邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：預測變數、空間域與時距定義任務。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for forecast boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Variables, domain and lead time define the task. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for observation errors. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Instrument, representation and sampling affect errors. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare synthetic point and grid-mean temperatures. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for background and innovations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Assimilation innovations compare observations and background in observation space. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compute y−Hx for a toy linear H. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for domain decomposition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Grid and spectral transforms can need different communication patterns. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy neighbor and global-transpose flows. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for deterministic verification. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RMSE, bias and regional means measure different properties. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate errors and bias of synthetic forecasts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for release scope. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Educational models give no operational hazard-decision guarantee. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Label toy forecast errors and unvalidated scope. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「資料版本」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「同日期預測都用了完全相同觀測。」為何不成立。
提交「釋出範圍」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「標註玩具預報誤差與未驗證範圍。」如何辨別它們。
提交「釋出範圍」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「完成模擬便有正式災害預報資格。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for data versions; explain why this claim fails: All forecasts on one date use identical observations.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for release scope; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for release scope; explain why this claim fails: Completing a simulation qualifies operational hazard forecasts.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：完成模擬便有正式災害預報資格。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Completing a simulation qualifies operational hazard forecasts. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific chains. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Frontier 超級電腦架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Frontier supercomputer architecture
guides.concept: 以Frontier 異質節點、HBM 與通訊拓撲串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect frontier heterogeneous nodes, hbm and interconnect topology with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
